title: One medicine
expected: 1 row: Paracetamol, 500 mg, 1 tablet, twice daily, after food, 5 days. Morning/Afternoon/Night show 'Not specified' because 'twice daily' does not say which times of day, and a note asks the user to check the times with a pharmacist.

title: Several medicines
checks: Every medicine becomes its own row with its own instructions.
expected: 4 rows. Abbreviations are expanded (TDS = Three times daily). Pantoprazole shows Morning because 'before breakfast' is written. No medicine is added or dropped.

title: Morning and night timings
checks: Dose patterns like 1-0-1 are mapped to the correct columns.
expected: Metformin: Morning ✓, Afternoon —, Night ✓. Atorvastatin: Night ✓ only. Both 30 days, after food / after dinner.

title: Missing dosage or duration
checks: Missing values are shown as 'Not specified', never filled in.
expected: Cetirizine: duration 'Not specified'. Ambroxol: dosage 'Not specified'. Vitamin D3: dosage, frequency and duration 'Not specified'. Each has a warning and the result is marked as needing verification.

title: Unclear or misread names
checks: Garbled OCR-style names are flagged, not guessed or corrected.
expected: Names are shown as 'Unclear – Confirm with Pharmacist/Doctor' (or flagged as not matching the text). The app must NOT silently turn 'Amox1c1l|in' into 'Amoxicillin'. A red verification banner appears.
